description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainUvData to obtain statistics about unique visitors (UVs) for accelerated domain names at a 1-hour granularity. You can query data from the last 90 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainUvData获取加速域名1小时粒度的UV页面独立访问统计，支持获取最近90天的数据
name: DescribeDcdnDomainUvData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can query data for only one domain name at a time.

If you leave this parameter empty, data for all your accelerated domain names is queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，仅支持查询单个域名。

默认查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between data points, in seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，以秒为单位

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range

UsageData.description_en: The number of unique visitors in each time interval
UsageData.description_zh: 每个时间间隔的页面独立访问次数

TimeStamp.description_en: The start of the time slice
